description: Look up patient-friendly health information for an ICD-10-CM diagnosis code via the NLM MedlinePlus Connect service. Returns MedlinePlus topic titles, URLs, and plain-language summaries for conditions matching the code (e.g. E11 → Type 2 Diabetes, J18.9 → Pneumonia, I21 → Myocardial Infarction). Supports English and Spanish responses (language=es). Used in EHR/clinical contexts to link clinical codes to patient education materials. Source: US NLM MedlinePlus Connect — public domain, no auth, unlimited free.

code.description: ICD-10-CM diagnosis code to look up (e.g. E11 for Type 2 Diabetes, J18.9 for Pneumonia).

language.description: Response language: en (English) or es (Spanish). Default: en.

name: medlineplus.clinical.icd10_lookup

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: MedlinePlus Connect — ICD-10 Code Lookup
